en.name: Baby food, vegetables
en.summary: Baby vegetable purée — carrot, sweet potato, pea, squash, green bean — is a low-acid food with nothing in it to slow bacteria down. Opened and covered, it keeps 2 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, a day less than fruit, and only if it has never been fed from directly with a used spoon. Unopened, go by the use-by date on the jar or pouch and discard it after that.
en.pantry: The sealed container is safe on the shelf to its printed date because it was heat-processed hard enough to handle a low-acid food, and that same processing is why you cannot judge one by eye afterwards. Keep jars and pouches somewhere cool and dark, standing upright, and check the pack rather than the purée: a lid button that clicks under your thumb, a bulging or leaking pouch, or a seal that hisses when it should pop, and the container goes in the bin unopened. For the opened product there is no room-temperature figure at all.
en.fridge: Two days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, lid on. Vegetable purée is the harder one to read, because it does not brown the way fruit does and does not smell strongly when it turns — a sour or yeasty note is often the only warning, and a starchy purée such as sweet potato or squash simply goes gluey. If you make your own, keep nitrate-rich vegetables in mind: spinach, carrot and beetroot purées should not be held warm or reheated over and over, because nitrate converts to nitrite on standing and infants are the group that matters for. Never dip a spoon that has been in the baby's mouth back into the container; the remainder cannot be saved after that. Serve from a bowl and discard what is left in it.
en.freezer: Vegetable purée is the best of these to batch-freeze. Cook it, blend it, cool it fast and freeze it the same day in an ice cube tray, then tip the frozen cubes into a labelled bag so you can take out one or two at a time. Commercial jars, by contrast, separate on thawing and are not worth the trouble. Anything already thawed, warmed or eaten from is not refrozen.
en.thawing: Thaw a cube in the fridge rather than on the counter, and warm it through once. Microwaved purée heats in pockets, so stir it properly and test a little on the inside of your wrist before it goes near the baby.
spoilage: A vacuum button that clicks when pressed — discard the jar without opening it.
A swollen or leaking pouch, or any hissing or spurting when opened.
A sour or off smell, or a purée that has darkened noticeably.
Mould around the rim, under the lid or at the spout.
tips: Spoon a portion into a bowl; never feed from the container with a used spoon.
Write the date and time on the jar when you open it.
Vegetable purées are low-acid, so give them the shortest window rather than the benefit of the doubt.
Never give honey to a baby under one year old — it can carry the spores that cause infant botulism.

faq.q: How long does opened baby vegetable purée keep?
faq.a: 2 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, covered, and only if it has never been fed from directly.

faq.q: Why do vegetables keep less well than fruit once opened?
faq.a: Vegetable purées are low-acid, so there is nothing holding bacteria back. Fruit purées are acidic and get a slightly longer window.

faq.q: Can you keep what is left after feeding?
faq.a: No. Once a used spoon has been in it, saliva has carried bacteria into the food and the remainder must be thrown away.

zh.name: 嬰兒蔬菜泥
zh.summary: 嬰兒蔬菜泥——紅蘿蔔、地瓜、豌豆、南瓜、四季豆——是低酸食品，裡面沒有任何東西可以拖慢細菌。開封後蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏 2 天，比水果泥少一天，而且前提是從來沒有用餵過的湯匙直接挖過。未開封的以罐子或軟袋上的有效日期為準，過期就丟。
zh.pantry: 未開封的可以常溫放到標示日期，因為它經過足以處理低酸食品的高強度加熱；也正因為如此，開封前你沒辦法用眼睛判斷裡面好不好。玻璃罐和軟袋請立著收在陰涼避光的地方，要檢查的是包裝而不是泥本身：蓋子真空鈕按下去會彈、軟袋鼓脹或滲漏、該啵一聲卻變成嘶嘶漏氣，這一罐就不要開，直接丟。至於開封後的蔬菜泥，完全沒有室溫天數可言。
zh.fridge: 蓋好放 4 °C 以下 2 天。蔬菜泥是比較難判讀的一種，因為它不像水果泥會褐變，壞掉時氣味也不明顯——常常只有一點點酸味或酵母味當警訊，而地瓜、南瓜這類澱粉多的泥，則是先變得黏糊。如果是自己做的，要記得硝酸鹽含量高的蔬菜：菠菜、紅蘿蔔、甜菜根打的泥不要長時間保溫、也不要反覆回熱，因為放著會讓硝酸鹽轉成亞硝酸鹽，而嬰兒正是最需要在意這件事的族群。進過寶寶嘴巴的湯匙絕對不要再放回容器，那之後剩下的就救不回來了。請從碗裡餵，碗裡剩的丟掉。
zh.freezer: 蔬菜泥是這幾種裡最值得一次做一批冷凍起來的。煮好、打勻、快速降溫，當天就用製冰盒分格冷凍，凍硬後倒進貼了標籤的袋子，之後一次拿一兩塊就好。相對地，市售玻璃罐解凍後會分離，不值得費這個工。已經解凍、加熱或餵過的，不要再冷凍。
zh.thawing: 凍塊請放冷藏解凍，不要放在檯面上，加熱一次就好。微波過的泥是一塊一塊熱的，請確實攪拌，再滴一點在手腕內側試溫，然後才給寶寶。
spoilage: 真空鈕按下去會響——不要打開，整罐丟掉。
軟袋鼓脹或滲漏，或開封時嘶嘶作響、噴出來。
聞起來發酸或有異味，或泥的顏色明顯變深。
瓶口、蓋子內側或吸嘴處出現霉。
tips: 舀一份到碗裡；絕對不要用餵過的湯匙就著容器餵。
開封時在罐子上寫下日期和時間。
蔬菜泥是低酸食品，請給它最短的期限，不要往寬鬆的方向想。
未滿一歲的寶寶絕對不能吃蜂蜜——它可能帶有引起嬰兒肉毒桿菌中毒的孢子。

faq.q: 開封的嬰兒蔬菜泥可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏 2 天，而且前提是從來沒有直接從裡面餵過。

faq.q: 為什麼蔬菜泥開封後比水果泥更不耐放？
faq.a: 蔬菜泥是低酸食品，沒有酸度可以壓住細菌。水果泥偏酸，期限稍微長一點。
不行。只要餵過的湯匙進去過，口水就已經把細菌帶進食物裡，剩下的必須丟掉。
